title: [SOA] Keep setup buffer current after instruction sync (AB#660003)
summary: The SOA Setup timestamp helper now saves through the caller's buffer instead of a separate record, ensuring the row version stays current and preventing stale-record errors during scheduling.
key_points: Fixed stale-record error 85132286 that could occur when ScheduleSOAgent tried to modify an outdated SOA Setup record
Timestamp helper now persists to the existing caller's buffer instead of a separate CurrentSOASetup record
Prevents the caller's row version from becoming stale after instruction sync updates
Maintains optimistic concurrency and avoids unnecessary reloads of pending values
Preserves existing behavior for missing-record checks, scheduling logic, and 30-minute refresh intervals
